response.justification: Bogdan has extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL-relevant tools, plus strong architecture and DevOps exposure, but his title history suggests senior-level expertise far beyond the junior/mid role, and his German language barrier and high on-site requirement raise red flags for cultural and operational fit.
strengths: Strong TypeScript and React/Node.js full-stack experience
Proven experience with REST APIs, databases, and scalable architecture
Active open-source contributions and deep understanding of software craftsmanship
concerns: Overqualified with senior titles, risking misalignment with junior role expectations
German language proficiency is only basic, conflicting with high on-site needs in Berlin
Diverse tech stack (DLang, C++, etc.) may indicate fragmented focus or difficulty in team alignment
